author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: Japanese anime art style (see attached images), Experience with 2D game character art, Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors), work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out! Contact: DM/PM on Facebook.

author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Procreate Illustrator and Colorist
content: A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY! I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested! 1) A COLORIST who will create a mobile phone video recording of themselves coloring in one of my Viva Chroma Coloring Pages. 2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR who is able to use procreate and who is able to HAND FINISH my coloring page designs. These will be very simple bold and easy designs to begin with. You will not be required to draw from scratch - I will provide you with all of my coloring pages. Contact: DM on Facebook. Proposed fee required for application.
